title: Librarian provides:overlap drift allowlist
description: Validates ${CLAUDE_HOME}/hooks/drift-allowlist.json — the source-of-truth for librarian provides:overlap exemptions. Edited directly by adopters; mirrored into librarian-manifest.json at /librarian run time. Hand-editing the manifest is forbidden — it is a generated read-replica; edit this source-of-truth instead.

_schema_version.description: Optional schema version pin. Foundation skeleton omits; future migrations may add.

provides_overlap.description: Exemption entries. Each entry declares an overlap that should NOT be flagged as drift by /librarian. Foundation skeleton ships an empty array.

capability.description: The capability whose provides overlap is exempted. The reader keys on this field: an entry without it is ignored.

skill.description: Informational: the skill or capability name claiming the provides label. The reader does not use it.

label.description: Informational: the provides label whose overlap is exempted. The reader does not use it.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale. Surfaced in librarian audit reports.
